goal: Look up web-1 in CMDB to determine its role, criticality, owner, and trust edges — and look up any host matching dev.dana's workstation.
what_to_summarize: any host with role office-ws or dev-ws associated with dev.dana
web-1 users override block if present

goal: Check whether dev.dana is authorized to access web-1 per the identity stub, and what role/permissions dev.dana has.
what_to_summarize: authorized: true/false for dev.dana on web-1

goal: Query nginx access logs on web-1 over a 7-day baseline window ending at the alert time to characterize normal traffic patterns: what source IPs appear, what paths are hit, response codes, and cadence.
what_to_summarize: distinct source.ip values seen over 7d baseline
distinct url.path values and their frequency
any off-host (non-127.0.0.1) source IPs in baseline
total request count over baseline period

params.query:
FROM logs-nginx.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-21T06:17:32Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T06:17:32Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
| STATS total_requests = COUNT(*),
        distinct_source_ips = COUNT_DISTINCT(source.ip),
        distinct_paths = COUNT_DISTINCT(url.path),
        off_host_requests = COUNT(*) WHERE source.ip != "127.0.0.1",
        loopback_requests = COUNT(*) WHERE source.ip == "127.0.0.1",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
| EVAL duration_hours = DATE_DIFF("hour", first_seen, last_seen)

FROM logs-nginx.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-21T06:17:32Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T06:17:32Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
| STATS requests = COUNT(*),
        distinct_paths = COUNT_DISTINCT(url.path),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY source.ip
| SORT requests DESC

FROM logs-nginx.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-21T06:17:32Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T06:17:32Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
| STATS requests = COUNT(*)
        BY http.response.status_code
| SORT requests DESC

FROM logs-nginx.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-21T06:17:32Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T06:17:32Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
| STATS requests = COUNT(*)
        BY url.path
| SORT requests DESC

FROM logs-nginx.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-21T06:17:32Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T06:17:32Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
| STATS requests = COUNT(*)
        BY user_agent.original
| SORT requests DESC

FROM logs-nginx.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-21T06:17:32Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T06:17:32Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
| EVAL hour = DATE_TRUNC(1 hour, @timestamp)
| STATS requests = COUNT(*)
        BY hour
| SORT hour ASC

goal: Query nginx access logs on web-1 for the alert time window (±15m around 2026-07-28T06:17:32Z) to characterize the web path scan: source IPs, url paths hit, HTTP methods, response codes, user agents, and timing pattern.
what_to_summarize: source.ip of all requests in the window
url.path or url.original for each request
timestamp distribution / timing pattern (burst vs spread)

params.query:
FROM logs-nginx.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-28T06:02:32Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-28T06:32:32Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
| STATS requests = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY host.name,
           source.ip,
           path = url.path,
           method = http.request.method,
           status = http.response.status_code,
           user_agent = user_agent.original
| SORT requests DESC, first_seen ASC
